title: THE LITTLE-KNOWN MYSTERY OF FLIGHT 19

scenes.text: Five planes disappeared over the Bermuda Triangle in 1945.
The planes were on a training mission with 14 crew members.
Despite extensive searches, no trace of the planes was ever found.
Flight 19's fate remains unknown to this day.
Follow for the cases that were never solved.

description: In 1945, Flight 19's mysterious disappearance in the Bermuda Triangle remains one of aviation’s greatest enigmas. Explore the facts surrounding this unresolved case. #shorts #aviationmystery #Flight19 #BermudaTriangle #fyp
